'''Solida Hesk's resort''' was a tourist resort located on a [[mesa]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. During the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] takeover of the planet, it was the site of a summit between three Hutt clan leaders hosted by the resort's owner, [[Solida Hesk]].
